checks.name: shares sum to one within each region
checks.sql: select count(*) from (select region, sum(share_of_region) as s from main.product_region_share group by 1) where abs(s - 1) > 1e-9

checks.name: revenue matches the sales
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.product_region_share p full outer join (select region, product_id, sum(amount) as revenue from raw.sales group by 1, 2) e using (region, product_id) where p.revenue is distinct from e.revenue
